description.value: Macchiato Caffe is a locally owned Italian-inspired cafe with two locations in downtown Victoria, serving premium Caffe Umbria espresso alongside freshly made panini, salads, and baked goods — all prepared onsite daily. After nearly two decades in Victoria, it has become a neighbourhood institution drawing on ingredients sourced through its Italian deli supplier, Italian Food Imports. Both locations offer comfortable indoor seating and outdoor patio space, making it a welcoming mid-ride stop in the heart of downtown.
